acceptanceResults: Work Item verification uses a dynamic profile-authorized path for the detected project command; explicit custom commands remain fresh unless reuse is explicitly requested.
The dynamic reusable path may reuse only a valid identity-bound receipt whose repository, profile, runtime, command, scope, stage, runner, base, toolchain, dependency, and policy context all match.
A reused result records a fresh Work Item verification evidence binding and never skips required/protected governance nodes.

Any changed snapshot, command, scope, stage, runner, runtime, profile, toolchain, dependency, or malformed/tampered receipt denies reuse and executes the declared verification command; unknown impact never becomes green by timing or cache state.
The selection decision reports executed, reused, escalated, and denied reasons so an Agent can distinguish a precise warm path from a required cold path.
Current ai-cockpit and a fresh isolated adopter both demonstrate measurable cold versus warm behavior using the installed Runtime after release; no source/build fallback is used.
Three-language documentation explains the dynamic selection boundary, evidence identity, and that timing/reuse never authorizes weaker governance.
